title: MATLAB-compatible function interface specification
description: Machine-readable, implementation-neutral specification of an observable function interface. Authored in YAML, validated against this schema. Records only facts and observations; every behavioural claim carries a status and, where applicable, provenance and observation references (constitution.md §2, §4, §7).

schema_version.description: Version of this interface-schema format that the file targets.

spec_version.description: Version of this specification's content. Bump on normative changes.

status.description: Review status of the whole specification. Only 'approved' specs may be exported (constitution §8).

applicable_releases.description: MATLAB release(s) this specification is written against, e.g. ['R2026a'].

summary.description: One or two sentences of original, factual wording describing what the function computes. No copied documentation prose.

inputs.description: Positional and varargin input arguments, in order.

name_value_arguments.description: Name-value arguments accepted by the function, if any.

dimension_selection.description: Rules for how the operating dimension is chosen (default and explicit).

vecdim_supported.description: Whether a vector of dimensions is accepted (release-dependent for some functions).

output_shape_rules.description: Statements about the shape of outputs as a function of inputs.

output_type_rules.description: Statements about the class/type of outputs as a function of inputs.

supported_input_domains.description: Cross-cutting facts about which input forms are accepted.

shapes.description: Scalar, vector, matrix, N-D, empty acceptance.

data_types.description: Accepted classes (double, single, integer types, logical, ...).

complex.description: Whether complex input is accepted and how it is treated.

sparse.description: Whether sparse input is accepted and how it is treated.

warnings.description: Conditions under which the function warns.

errors.description: Conditions under which the function errors.

numerical_edge_cases.description: Observable numerical edge cases (e.g. even-count averaging, ties, empty).

nan_infinity_behaviour.description: Behaviour in the presence of NaN, +Inf and -Inf.

linked_observations.description: Observation files that back this specification.

provenance_ref.description: Path to the provenance document for this function (e.g. 'provenance.yaml').

unresolved_questions.description: Open questions flagged for human review (constitution §8.2).

claim_status.description: confirmed = backed by a black-box observation or a public-interface fact; pending = asserted but not yet observed; unresolved = flagged for review.

claim.description: A single factual/behavioural statement with its verification status and provenance links.

id.description: Optional stable id, matching a claim_id in provenance.yaml.

normative.description: True if this is a required behaviour a conforming implementation must satisfy; false for non-normative notes/inferences.

provenance.description: claim_id in provenance.yaml that justifies this statement.

observations.description: References into observations/*.json backing this statement.

signature.description: A public call form, e.g. 'M = median(A)' or 'M = median(A, dim)'.

description.description: Original, factual description of this form.

accepted_shapes.description: Which array shapes are accepted for this argument.

accepts_complex.description: Whether complex values are accepted for this argument.

accepts_sparse.description: Whether sparse arrays are accepted for this argument.

default.description: Default value/behaviour when omitted; use null with a note if there is no simple default.

diagnostic.description: A warning or error condition. Record the identifier and a factual paraphrase of the condition — not full proprietary message text.

condition.description: Original, factual description of when the diagnostic occurs.

message_summary.description: Short factual paraphrase, not the verbatim proprietary message.
